sloka: पीड्यमानां स धर्मात्मा वैदेहीमनुचिन्तयन् ।क्षिप्रमाज्ञापयामास वानरान् द्विषतां वधे ।। ६.४२.९ ।।।।
transliteration: pīḍyamānāṁ sa dharmātmā vaidehīmanucintayan ।kṣipramājñāpayāmāsa vānarān dviṣatāṁ vadhe ।। 6.42.9 ।।।।

translations.english: Thinking of Vaidehi again and again, who is pained, Rama ordered the Vanaras to kill the enemies immediately.
